Priya S.: Heads up — we have a backlog impacting EU private deployments' indexing pipeline. ~15 onboarding tenants seeing `409` or delayed index confirmation. Pushing proactive comms now.
Connor M.: is that across Dedicated and Private or just Private? any tenants in renewal window?
Priya S.: private only (on-prem/vpc). I pulled the list: 15 tenants, 6 high-touch, 3 trials, 2 renew within 45 days. Sheet: https://redir.company/sheets/EU-priv-index-6054
Eve (CS): thanks. CS ask: short status + RCA follow-up, trial extension auto, and offer to run a manual reindex for any tenant that requests. Can we standardize the credit/offset language for AMs?
Jules - Product: root cause: long-tail Java GC pause on indexer process under certain dataset sizes leading to connection resets and a cascade retry that backpressured the queue. Deployed GC tuning + circuit breaker logic and a bulk replay task.
ops-bot: deploy completed by infra at 05:12 UTC — replay job queued for 15 tenants.
Priya S.: scope note: partial index writes observed for ~0.8% of onboarding docs. No user data loss expected; records will be reindexed.
Ria - AM: for the two renewals, recommend contacting them directly. What bridge credit amounts should we suggest?
Connor M.: propose quick guidance: SMB (<25k ARR) — $300 credit or 2 weeks onboarding support; Growth (25-150k) — $750 credit or 1 month of priority onboarding; Strategic (150k+) — bespoke credit + free 1:1 technical onboarding session. Finance sign-off pending.
Eve (CS): drafting two emails now: 1) high-touch personalized note 2) bulk templated notice for the rest. I'll paste drafts here for review.
Priya S.: paste them in this thread and I'll send after sign-off.
Eve (CS): High-touch draft:
Subject: We fixed an indexing delay affecting your onboarding — offer for direct help

Hi {{first_name}},

TL;DR: We identified and fixed an issue that caused delayed indexing for some onboarding events in EU private deployments. We've queued reindex jobs for affected tenants and will follow up once complete.

What we did:
• Tuned indexer JVM GC settings and added a circuit breaker to prevent queue backpressure.
• Triggered a prioritized reindex for affected data sets.
• Added extra monitoring and alerts on index throughput.

How we'll make this right:
• We can run a manual reindex on request (priority).
• Offering a one-time account credit or a free 1:1 onboarding deep-dive with our solutions team.

If you'd like us to reindex your tenant or schedule a walk-through, reply and we’ll set it up within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Redwood Customer Success

Priya S.: looks good. add the FAQ link and a line about trial extensions for the trials.
Eve (CS): bulk template (short):
Subject: Status update — indexing delays in EU private deployments (resolved)

Hi,

We encountered delays that affected some onboarding indexing jobs. The fix is deployed and replays are running. No action required on your part; if you notice missing items, reply and we’ll reindex.

FAQ: https://redir.company/faq/6054
Survey: https://redir.company/surveys/impact?tid={{tenant_id}}

Jules - Product: quick FAQ blurb you can copy:
Q: Is my data safe?
A: Yes — there is no data loss. Some documents were delayed in indexing and are being replayed.

Q: Will this affect live queries?
A: Short-term stale search results possible until reindex completes. Read-only data is not affected.
